mechanism: Tazarotene is a potent teratogen requiring strict contraception; mesalamine may have minor effects on folate metabolism which could theoretically compromise contraceptive efficacy or increase fetal risk if used together in reproductive-age patients.
action: Ensure reliable contraception in females of childbearing potential; counsel on teratogenic risks of tazarotene and avoid concurrent use in pregnancy; monitor for any GI symptoms as both drugs affect GI tract.
